rationale: The assistant correctly identified iced-evaporator and defrost-system failure, recommended a safe 24h manual defrost, warned against chipping ice, and noted that a recurrence points to the defrost system. It never asked for frost on the freezer back panel or the full model number, and it only briefly mentioned the warranty and technician route. The 'very likely a fan blade hitting ice' claim is slightly confident, but it named no specific part as the definite cause. The conversation ended before the defrost result, so it is partial.
